text: [THE RIGHT WAY]{.secondary-alt} IS THE ONLY WAY, PERIOD. THERE IS NO ROOM FOR DOUBT, NO SPACE FOR DEVIATION, PERIOD. IN EVERY DECISION, IN EVERY ACTION, WE [FOLLOW]{.secondary-alt} THE PATH THAT ALIGNS WITH OUR [TRUE VALUES]{.secondary-alt}. TO STRAY IS TO LOSE SIGHT OF WHAT IS CLEAR AND TRUE.
